description: Deliver a stored escrow deposit bundle to the configured escrow agent over SFTP (companies escrowDelivery config + the company's own SFTP key). Requires `write` scope. Stamps the ledger with deliveredAt + a delivery receipt (remotePath, bundleSha256).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_deliver_escrow_deposit
title: Deliver escrow deposit
